{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the structure of revenue
print("First 5 values of revenue:")
print(sales['revenue'].head())

# Check if there are any non-numeric characters (like commas)
print("\nUnique values in revenue (first 10):")
print(sales['revenue'].unique()[:10])

# Check for thousands separators
revenue_sample = sales['revenue'].sample(5, random_state=42)
print("\nSample of revenue values (as strings):")
print(revenue_sample)"}
